preconditions.description: The number of people n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The boat's weight limit k is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(weights) == n and all(w in (50, 100) for w in weights)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n weights, each being either 50 or 100.

postconditions.description: If transporting everyone is impossible, min_rides is -1; otherwise it is the minimum number of rides.
If transporting everyone is impossible, ways is 0; otherwise it is the count of distinct ways modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: not is_impossible and min_rides == min(rides for rides in valid_sequences if all_transported(rides))
postconditions.description: When possible, min_rides is the minimum number of boat crossings required to move all n people from the starting bank to the destination bank, respecting the weight limit k and the requirement that the boat carries at least one person.

When possible, ways is the number of distinct sequences of boat loads (sets of people) of length min_rides that successfully transport everyone, modulo 10^9+7. Two sequences are distinct if they differ in the set of people on the boat for at least one ride.
The output consists of two lines: the first is the minimum number of rides (or -1), and the second is the number of ways modulo 10^9+7 (or 0).
